قناة مائية تاريخية جارية تحت الأرض، يبدأ: A historic underground water channel that begins at the Azraq well in a garden near Quba Mosque and runs north towards the city; tradition credits Marwan ibn al-Hakam with building it.
أقدم مقابر المدينة المنورة وأكبرها، ويقع: The oldest and largest cemetery in Madinah, beside the south-eastern wall of the Prophet's Mosque and named after the gharqad bushes that once grew there. Many Companions, and several of the Prophet's wives and daughters, are buried here.
مسجد تاريخي في المدينة المنورة، يُعد من: A historic mosque in Madinah, counted among the mosques where the Prophet prayed.
أكبر مساجد المساجد السبعة، يقع على السفح: The largest of the Seven Mosques, on the western slope of Mount Sela' west of the Prophet's Mosque, near the cemetery of the Trench martyrs. It was built in stone by Umar ibn Abdulaziz between 705 and 711 and takes its name from Surah Al-Fath.
من أقدم مساجد المدينة، يقع غرب المسجد ال: One of the oldest mosques in Madinah, just west of the Prophet's Mosque, where tradition holds that the Prophet led an Eid prayer and a prayer for rain. It is among the city's historic mosques that have been restored.
ممشى على مسار الهجرة في اتجاه قباء، يبعد: A walking trail on the Hijrah route in the Quba direction, about 2.8 km from Quba Mosque.
مصلى نبوي صغير شمال المسجد النبوي، ارتبط: A small Prophetic prayer place north of the Prophet's Mosque, tied to the hadith in which the Prophet asked God for three things and two were granted. It is also known as Masjid Bani Mu'awiya and lies about 600 m from the Prophet's Mosque.
من أقدم المساجد التي بُنيت بعد هجرة النب: One of the oldest mosques built after the Prophet's migration, in the Quba area, where tradition holds that the Prophet led the first Friday prayer in Madinah.
مسجد المستراح، أحد المساجد التاريخية في: Al-Mustarah Mosque, one of the historic mosques of Madinah.
المسجد الذي تحولت فيه القبلة من بيت المق: The mosque where the prayer direction was changed from Jerusalem to Makkah, which gave it its name; it dates to around 623 CE. It is a main stop on Madinah's ziyarat tours.
مسجد علي بن أبي طالب: Ali ibn Abi Talib Mosque (near the Prophet's Mosque)
مسجد تاريخي صغير قريب من المسجد النبوي و: A small historic mosque close to the Prophet's Mosque and to Al-Ghamama Mosque.
مسجد من المساجد التي صلى فيها النبي صلى: A mosque in Madinah where the Prophet prayed, named after the nearby Saqiya well.
مسجد في شعب بني حرام، يُذكر أن بركة تكثي: A mosque in Shi'b Bani Haram, beside which the miraculous increase of food is said to have occurred during the Trench campaign.
مسجد تاريخي في قرية بني أنيف جنوب غرب مس: A historic mosque in the village of Bani Anif, south-west of Quba Mosque on the right side of the Hijrah route, restored during King Salman's reign and notable for its open timber ceiling.
موقع بستان تاريخي في منطقة قباء يُزار مع: A historic garden site in the Quba area, visited together with Quba Mosque on Hijrah-themed tours and described as the place where the Prophet and Abu Bakr were welcomed on arriving in Madinah.
ميقات أهل المدينة ومن مرّ بها لإحرام الح: The miqat where pilgrims coming via Madinah enter ihram for Hajj and Umrah, about 14 km from the Prophet's Mosque and also known as Abyar Ali. The modern complex includes a mosque and service facilities.
بئر في حي العوالي حفرها مالك بن النحاط ف: A well in the Al-Awali neighbourhood dug by Malik ibn al-Nahhat in the Prophet's time; the Prophet drew water from it and asked that his body be washed with its water after his death.
تل صغير عند سفح جبل أحد وضع عليه النبي ص: A small hill near the foot of Mount Uhud where the Prophet stationed fifty archers to guard the army's rear. Visitors can climb it for a panoramic view of the Martyrs Square and the battlefield.
أول مسجد بُني في الإسلام، أسسه النبي صلى: The first mosque built in Islam, founded by the Prophet on his arrival in Madinah in 622 CE, south of the city and about 3.5 km from the Prophet's Mosque.
الساحة المركزية بجوار مسجد قباء ونقطة بد: The central square beside Quba Mosque and the starting point of the Quba Walking Trail.
ممشى للمشاة بطول نحو 3 كم يربط المسجد ال: A pedestrian trail of about 3 km linking the Prophet's Mosque and Quba Mosque, following the path the Prophet took on his visits to Quba, with shops, food stalls and seating along the way.
موضع الاجتماع التاريخي الذي التقى فيه ال: The historic gathering place where the Ansar and the Muhajirun met after the Prophet's death and pledged allegiance to Abu Bakr. It lies north-west of the Prophet's Mosque and can be reached on foot.
مسجد كبير ضمن ساحة سيد الشهداء المطورة ب: A large mosque in the redeveloped Sayyid Al-Shuhada Square near the Uhud martyrs' cemetery, holding up to 15,000 worshippers, among the largest in Madinah after the Prophet's Mosque.
موقع غزوة الخندق: Site of the Battle of the Trench (Al-Khandaq)
الموقع المرتبط بغزوة الخندق (627م) التي: The area associated with the Battle of the Trench (627 CE), when a trench was dug to defend Madinah on the advice of Salman al-Farisi. It is included in Madinah's programme to restore Islamic historic sites.
مجموعة من المساجد الصغيرة التاريخية عند: A group of small historic mosques at the foot of Mount Sela' near the site of the Battle of the Trench (627 CE), including the Fatimah, Ali, Umar, Salman al-Farsi and al-Fath mosques. Visitors often add Al-Qiblatayn Mosque to the same trip.
الساحة المطورة المحيطة بمقبرة شهداء أحد: The redeveloped square around the Uhud martyrs' cemetery and Sayyid Al-Shuhada Mosque, with walking paths, shaded vendor areas and transport facilities for visitors.
مدفن نحو سبعين صحابياً استُشهدوا في غزوة: The burial place of about seventy Companions martyred in the Battle of Uhud, including Hamza ibn Abdulmuttalib, next to Mount Uhud.
مسجد عمر بن الخطاب: Umar ibn Al-Khattab Mosque (near the Prophet's Mosque)
مسجد تاريخي ضمن مجموعة المساجد القديمة غ: A historic mosque in the cluster of old mosques west of the Prophet's Mosque, alongside Al-Ghamama and Abu Bakr mosques, and one of the historic sites in Madinah that have been restored.
قصر أثري على ضفاف وادي العقيق يبعد نحو 3: An archaeological palace on the banks of Wadi Al-Aqiq, about 3.5 km from the Prophet's Mosque on the road to Dhu al-Hulayfah, with three courtyards and a well inside and another outside. It is among the valley's historic palaces.
بئر تُعرف ببئر الخاتم نسبة إلى سقوط خاتم: The well known as the Ring Well (Bir al-Khatam), after the story of the Prophet's ring falling into it, close to Quba Mosque. It is also called the Well of Aris.
بئر رومة (بئر عثمان): Well of Rumah (Uthman ibn Affan's Well)
بئر تاريخية شمال غرب المسجد النبوي، اشتر: A historic well north-west of the Prophet's Mosque, bought and endowed for public use by Uthman ibn Affan. It supplied water to the people of Madinah and its visitors for a long time.
ممشى بطول 1600 متر على امتداد وادي العقي: A 1,600 m walkway along Wadi Al-Aqiq with shaded seating areas and tree-lined paths, about 6 km from the Prophet's Mosque.
مجموعة مزارع نخيل متصلة في العالية على ط: A series of connected palm farms in Al-Aliyah on Ali ibn Abi Talib Road, about 1 km from the Prophet's Mosque, with dense palm groves, places selling dates and areas to sit and walk among the trees. Suitable for families and individuals.
الجبل الواقع في الجهة الجنوبية من المدين: The mountain on Madinah's southern side, a quiet spot for reflection and exploration with natural views over the south of the city.
جبل طويل من الجرانيت الأحمر والصخور الدا: A long mountain of red granite and dark rock north of Madinah, about 7 km in length, and the site of the Battle of Uhud in 625 CE. Its hollows collect rainwater and its slopes are home to more than 80 plant species.
الوادي المبارك في المدينة المنورة، وتنتش: The 'blessed valley' of Madinah, lined with historic monuments including the palaces of Saad bin Abi Waqqas and Urwa ibn al-Zubayr, and counted among the region's protected areas.
وادٍ خارج المدينة على بعد نحو 30 كم شمال: A valley outside the city, about 30 km north-west of Madinah, known as the 'Magnetic Hill', where cars left in neutral seem to roll uphill, commonly explained as an optical illusion. It is a popular weekend camping spot for locals.
مطعم في فندق ميلينيوم العقيق يقدم بوفيها: Restaurant at the Millennium Al Aqeeq Hotel serving Asian-inspired buffets, steps from the Prophet's Mosque.
مطعم عربي تقليدي في حي الحمراء بالمدينة: Traditional Arabic restaurant in the Al Hamra area of Madinah.
مطعم سعودي تقليدي وسط المدينة يشتهر بالك: Traditional Saudi restaurant in the centre of the city, known for kabsa, madfoon (slow-cooked lamb) and mezze in a warm setting.
مطعم محلي في حي الراية يُعرف بالأرز المق: Neighbourhood restaurant in Al Rayah, known for its fried rice and chicken.
مطعم شامي في منطقة المبعوث على طريق المل: Levantine (Shami) restaurant in the Al Mabuth area, on King Abdullah Road.
مطعم في فندق شذا المدينة بحي السلطانة يق: Restaurant at the Shaza Al Madina Hotel in Al-Sultanah serving a mix of Mediterranean, Middle Eastern and Asian dishes, in both buffet and a la carte formats.
محل شاورما وبيتزا بالطابع المغربي في الع: Moroccan-style shawarma and pizza spot in Al Aziziyah, known for its shawarma on Moroccan bread.
مطعم يمني في حي الفتح تُعرف قائمته بالفح: Yemeni restaurant in Al Fath, known for dishes such as fahsa and lamb burma.
Restaurant in Al Iskan serving fateer (savoury pastry).
مطعم باكستاني وهندي يُعرف بالبرياني، ومن: Pakistani and Indian restaurant known for its biryani, including a Hyderabadi mutton biryani and a Karachi-style chicken biryani.
كافتيريا يمنية في حي الملك فهد تُعرف بأط: Yemeni cafeteria in King Fahd District known for dishes such as areeka and masoub.
مطعم يمني يقع قرب المسجد النبوي، يقدم ال: Yemeni-style restaurant near the Prophet's Mosque serving mandi and kabsa on large sharing platters, suitable for families.
مطعم باكستاني بطابع منزلي في العوالي يُع: Home-style Pakistani restaurant in Al Awali, known for its generous portions.
فرع سلسلة هارديز العالمية للبرجر في المد: Branch of the international burger chain Hardee's in Madinah, serving fast food with a local twist.
مطعم عائلي محلي في حي العريض على طريق ال: Local family restaurant in Al-Areed on King Abdullah Road, popular with residents.
مطعم تركي على مسافة قريبة سيراً من المسج: Turkish restaurant within walking distance of the Prophet's Mosque, popular with Turkish pilgrims for its pide and kebab.
مطعم هندي يشتهر بالبرياني الغني بالنكهات: Indian restaurant known for its rich, fragrant biryani.
مطعم يقدم الكبسة والمندي ويُعرف بمندي ال: Restaurant serving kabsa and mandi, known for its chicken mandi.
مطعم على طريق الملك عبدالله الفرعي يقدم: Restaurant on King Abdullah Branch Road offering Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cooking with Lebanese and Turkish influences, known for its khashkhash kebab.
محل حلويات ومخبوزات في حي الملك فهد يشته: Sweets and bakery shop in King Fahd District, known for its basbousa, with baklava, kunafa and pastries on the menu.
مطعم باكستاني ملتاني في العوالي يُعرف بك: Pakistani Multani restaurant in Al Awali, known for its white mutton karahi, mutton curry and paratha.
Chicken shawarma shop in Al Aziziyah, known for its flavour.
مطعم صيني متخصص في الديم سم والنودلز وأط: Chinese restaurant specialising in dim sum, noodles and rice dishes.
سوق قريب من المسجد النبوي يُعرف بمطاعمه: Market area near the Prophet's Mosque known for its popular local eateries.
مطعم جلوس في طريق سلطانة بأجواء المطاعم: Sit-down restaurant on Sultanah Road with an American-diner feel, serving burgers, fajitas and steaks with a Saudi twist; it suits families and groups.
مطعم برجر ومشويات في حي الخاتم بالمدينة: Burger and grill restaurant in the Al Khatim area of Madinah.
مطعم هندي شمالي راقٍ في فندق ذا أوبروي ا: North Indian fine-dining restaurant at The Oberoi, Madina, with views over the Prophet's Mosque piazza.
مطعم ياباني متخصص في السوشي بالمدينة الم: Japanese sushi restaurant in Madinah, known for its sushi rolls.
مطعم أرز بخاري في حي الرانوناء يُعرف بال: Bukhari rice restaurant in Ar Ranuna, known for kabsa, chicken biryani and alfaham with rice.
مطعم عائلي يقدم المأكولات الآسيوية الجنو: Family-friendly South Asian and Arabic restaurant near the Prophet's Mosque, popular with groups; its mutton biryani is a highlight.
مطعم في المدينة المنورة يقدم الأطباق الم: Restaurant serving traditional Madani dishes; its name means 'My Grandfather's Time'.
مقهى قهوة مختصة على طريق الملك عبدالله ي: Specialty coffee shop on King Abdullah Road known for its breakfast options, sweets and outdoor seating; the caramel French toast and espresso hot chocolate are recommended.
مقهى أنيق على طريق الملك عبدالله في حي ا: Chic coffee shop on King Abdullah Road in Al Sadd serving hot and iced coffee drinks and handmade pastries, known for its Turkish coffee and Spanish latte.
مقهى قهوة مختصة في منطقة قباء يُعرف بالف: Specialty coffee shop in the Quba area, known for its flat white, drip coffee and matcha.
مقهى في المدينة المنورة يُعرف بقهوته الم: Coffee shop in Madinah known for its balanced coffee and fresh desserts, especially its Madrid cheesecake.
فرع علامة القهوة المختصة السعودية «دوز»: Branch of the Saudi specialty-coffee brand Dose in Madinah.
مقهى بالقرب من طريق قباء يُعرف بالقهوة ا: Café just off Quba Road known for Turkish coffee, Moroccan mint tea and a date cheesecake that is good for sharing.
Café in the Quba area of Madinah.
مقهى قهوة مختصة في حي الزهراء يُعرف بجود: Specialty coffee shop in Al Zahra known for the quality of its drinks, including the Ethiopian V60 and hibiscus tea, with cookies on the menu.
مقهى قرب المسجد النبوي يشتهر بحلويات بلم: Café near the Prophet's Mosque known for Saudi-style desserts such as lavender cheesecake and Umm Ali French toast.
مقهى بطابع تراثي تديره مشاعل السحلي، يست: Traditional-style café run by Mashael Al-Sihli that recreates old Madinah life through its decor, drinks, desserts and local sayings displayed on its stairs.
مقهى حلويات في محور طريق سلطانة يشتهر بف: Dessert café on the Sultanah Road corridor, known for chocolate fondue and lava cake.
فرع سلسلة مقاهي نمق كافيه السعودية للقهو: Branch of the Saudi coffee-and-dessert chain Namq in Sultanah Gardens Mall, near the Islamic University of Madinah, with a menu ranging from Saudi coffee to flat whites and a passion fruit cortado.
مقهى في حي الزهراء بجلسات خارجية وأجواء: Café in Al Zahra with outdoor seating, a cosy atmosphere and good coffee.
مقهى بطابع إنجليزي في سلطانة، بأجواء داف: English-style café in Sultanah with a cosy atmosphere and partial views toward the Prophet's Mosque.
مكتبة محلية داخل النور مول في حي النزهة: A local bookstore inside Al Noor Mall in An Nuzhah, stocking Islamic books, educational titles and general reading.
مركز تسوق على طريق الملك عبدالله الفرعي: A shopping mall on King Abdullah Branch Road in Madinah, home to an adidas outlet store.
النور مول: Al Noor Mall (Cenomi Al Noor Mall)
مركز تسوق وترفيه على طريق الملك عبدالله: A shopping and entertainment mall on King Abdullah Road in An Nuzhah, with a food court and international fashion and footwear brands such as Zara, H&M, Mango, Nike and Adidas.
من أكبر مولات المدينة المنورة، يقع على ط: One of Madinah's largest malls, on King Abdullah (Second Ring) Road in the east of the city, with four floors, more than 400 stores, a cinema and a children's play area.
سوق سياحي قرب المسجد النبوي يبيع الهدايا: A tourist-oriented market near the Prophet's Mosque selling souvenirs, handicrafts, garments and fabrics, with a large gold and jewellery section; it is busiest during Hajj and Ramadan.
سوق التمور المركزي بالمدينة المنورة، تُب: Madinah's central dates market, where fresh and dried dates are sold in many varieties through daily auctions to local buyers, traders and visitors.
سوق قريب من المسجد النبوي يضم أكثر من 50: A market close to the Prophet's Mosque with more than 50 shops selling clothing, prayer mats, accessories, oud, chocolates and dates.
فرع لولو إكسبريس في المدينة المنورة يقدم: A Lulu Express supermarket in Madinah offering fresh produce, grocery essentials and international products.
هايبرماركت لولو على طريق الملك خالد قرب: Lulu hypermarket on King Khalid Road near the Haramain Train Station, the brand's largest store in Madinah, with groceries, fresh food, clothing, electronics and home appliances over two floors.
سوق تقليدي قريب جداً من المسجد النبوي، ي: A traditional bazaar very close to the Prophet's Mosque, a good place for gifts such as dates, perfumes, souvenirs, religious items, pilgrim supplies and jewellery.
من أقدم الأسواق التقليدية في المدينة الم: One of Madinah's oldest traditional markets, beside Al Manakha Square in the centre of the city, selling dates, prayer beads, abayas, perfumes and souvenirs.
سوق تاريخي غرب المسجد النبوي، اشتهر قديم: A historic market west of the Prophet's Mosque, long known for textiles, gold and perfume, rebuilt as a heritage market after a major fire in the 1970s; it now sells Madinah dates, oriental perfumes, prayer beads, fabrics and heritage gifts.
مركز تسوق داخلي قريب من المسجد النبوي، ي: An indoor shopping centre next to the Prophet's Mosque area, with many souvenir shops selling prayer beads, prayer mats, perfumes, clothing and accessories.
مكتبة تجمع بين بيع الكتب والاطلاع في حي: A combined bookstore and library in Badaah, offering religious texts, academic books and children's books.
حديقة عامة في حي الخالدية أنشأتها أمانة: A public park in Al-Khalidiyah created by the Madinah Municipality under its city-humanisation projects, with two children's play areas, pedestrian paths, a walking track, a football pitch and restrooms.
دار سينما في الراشد مول بعشر شاشات و764: A cinema in Al Rashid Mall with 10 screens and 764 seats, the first Empire Cinemas branch in Madinah.
حديقة عند سفح جبل أحد، وهي من حدائق المد: A garden at the foot of Mount Uhud, one of Madinah's public parks.
أبرز حدائق المدينة المنورة العامة، تقع ع: Madinah's main public park, about 5 km south of the Prophet's Mosque, with walking and running trails, children's playgrounds, a horse-riding area, an artificial lake, restaurants and cultural spaces.
وجهة عصرية مفتوحة بمساحة نحو 10 آلاف متر: A modern open-air destination of about 10,000 sq m on King Abdullah Road opposite Al-Noor Mall in Al-Raya, with cafes, restaurants, shaded rest areas and space for picnics and events.
نادٍ لكرة القدم في المدينة المنورة يلعب: A Madinah football club that plays its home matches at Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Stadium in the Al-Salam area.
ممشى وحديقة عامة على شارع عكرمة بن أبي ج: A public park and walkway on Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl Street in southwest Madinah, with a 1 km walking path, an 870 m cycling track, playgrounds, an interactive fountain and parking for 340 vehicles.
نادٍ لكرة القدم في المدينة المنورة يلعب: A Madinah football club that plays at Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Stadium in the Al-Salam area.
نادٍ لرياضة البادل في حي الدفاع، يضم عدة: A padel club in the Al Difa area with several courts, a VIP section and a sand volleyball court.
مدينة الأمير محمد بن عبدالعزيز الرياضية: Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Sports City (Stadium)
منشأة رياضية متعددة الأغراض في حي السلام: A multi-purpose sports complex in the Al-Salam district of west Madinah, with a natural-grass stadium of about 24,000 seats, a running track and an indoor sports hall. It is the home ground of the Al-Ansar and Ohud clubs.
مركز المدينة المنورة للبحوث والدراسات: Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah Research and Studies Center
مركز بحثي أُسس بوقف خيري دائم من الأمير: A research centre established through a lifelong charitable endowment by Prince Abdul Majeed bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, about 5.4 km from the Prophet's Mosque.
جامعة إسلامية حكومية تأسست عام 1961م وهي: A public Islamic university founded in 1961 as the Kingdom's second-oldest public university, offering Islamic and Arabic studies alongside law, business, computing, engineering, sciences and languages; its campus adjoins Taibah University.
جهة حكومية أُنشئت للمحافظة على المخطوطات: A government complex created to preserve endowment manuscripts and make them available to visitors, bringing together 34 endowment libraries, including the Library of the Holy Quran, the Public Library of Madinah and the Mahmoudiyya Library, with a digitisation and cataloguing centre.
مكتبة وقفية كبرى في المدينة المنورة تضم: A major endowment library in Madinah holding thousands of original manuscripts, including a large collection of Quranic manuscripts, and an important source for the study of historic Quran manuscripts.
مكتبة المسجد النبوي، وتقع قرب الباب 10 ف: The library of the Prophet's Mosque, near gate 10 on the mosque's western side, holding about 4,000 original manuscripts, a large digitised collection and more than 250 rare handwritten Qurans.
فرع المدينة المنورة للجامعة السعودية الإ: The Madinah branch of the Saudi Electronic University, whose students are invited to volunteer at the Prophet's Mosque during Ramadan.
جامعة حكومية تأسست عام 2003م ومقرها الرئ: A public university founded in 2003 and headquartered in Madinah, with branches in Yanbu, Al-Ula, Al-Hinakiyah, Khaybar, Al-Mahd and Badr.
مستشفى حكومي عام يُعنى بالأمراض الوبائية: A general government hospital that handles epidemic and tropical diseases and treats injuries from accidents on the Tabuk-Madinah road.
مستشفى وقفي في المدينة المنورة يخدم قاصد: An endowment hospital in Madinah serving visitors to the Prophet's Mosque.
مستشفى خاص يقدم الطوارئ والعلاج الطبيعي: A private hospital offering emergency medicine, physiotherapy and inpatient care for adults and children.
مستشفى حكومي كبير يقع على طريق خالد بن ا: A large government hospital on the Khalid bin Al-Walid side road in the University district, with a wide range of medical specialties.
مدينة طبية متكاملة تكونت من ثلاثة مستشفي: A comprehensive medical city formed from three Madinah hospitals (general, maternity and children, and mental health) and named after King Salman, offering emergency and outpatient care plus neuroscience, oncology, diabetes and heart centres.
مستشفى خاص يقع على شارع الأمير عبدالمجيد: A private hospital on Prince Abdulmajeed bin Abdulaziz Street in the Ash Shuraybat / Al-Hizam area.
شبكة الحافلات العامة في المدينة المنورة: The city's public bus network, overseen by the Madinah Region Development Authority, with routes across Madinah including a service linking the airport and the Prophet's Mosque.
حافلة سياحية (هوب أون هوب أوف) بمسارين ت: A City Sightseeing hop-on hop-off bus with two routes covering Madinah's main sites.
